newsitem.title: GERMANY: D. Telekom to cut mobile phone rates.
newsitem.headline: D. Telekom to cut mobile phone rates.

text.p: Deutsche Telekom AG said on Friday it would cut evening hour rates for mobile phone users and would extend the low-rate period by three hours.

Beginning in September, certain users of Deutsche Telekom MobilNet GmbH's D1 network would pay evening rates of 39 pfennigs per minute -- about a 60 percent cut from the current rate. the evening rate period would also begin at 5 p.m. instead of 8 p.m.
It would also cut rates 13 percent -- to 99 pfennigs per minute from 1.14 marks -- for business customers calling between 7 a.m. and 8 p.m. Their monthly fee would also fall to 44 marks from 54.
T-Mobile has 2.6 million customers and has battled Mannesmann Mobilfunk GmbH for the lead in Germany's mobile phone market. The unit of Mannesmann AG has about 2.7 million customers.
